headline.en: Madison Realty Capital Provides $127M Refi for Fort Lauderdale Multifamily
headline.zh: Madison Realty Capital 为劳德代尔堡多户住宅项目提供1.27亿美元再融资

summary.en: Madison Realty Capital supplied a $127 million construction takeout loan for the Arcadian, a newly completed 502-unit multifamily development in Fort Lauderdale's Sistrunk District. The loan refinances an existing $84.5 million construction loan from Centennial Bank issued in 2024 as the property leases up toward stabilization.
summary.zh: Madison Realty Capital 为劳德代尔堡 Sistrunk 区新落成的502套多户住宅项目 Arcadian 提供了1.27亿美元的建筑工程置换贷款。该贷款用于再融资 Centennial Bank 于2024年发放的现有8,450万美元建筑贷款，项目正持续出租并迈向社会稳定期。

source.publisher: Commercial Real Estate Financing | Commercial Observer

items.source_headline: Madison Realty Capital Supplies $127M Refi for Fort Lauderdale Development

headline.en: Gulf Islamic Investments buys majority stake in London House Exchange
headline.zh: Gulf Islamic Investments 收购 London House Exchange 多数股权

summary.en: Gulf Islamic Investments, a UAE-based Shari'ah-compliant alternatives manager with more than $3bn in assets, has acquired a majority stake in UK property investment platform London House Exchange from Nasdaq-listed Better Home & Finance Holding Company, after FCA approval. GII said it plans to take the platform beyond UK property into Shari'ah-compliant income-generating investments, private credit and equity-linked products, and to explore regulated tokenisation and wider geographic reach. Better will remain a strategic minority shareholder in LHX.
summary.zh: 总部位于阿联酋、管理资产超过 30 亿美元的符合伊斯兰教法的另类投资管理公司 Gulf Islamic Investments，已从纳斯达克上市的 Better Home & Finance Holding Company 手中收购英国房地产投资平台 London House Exchange 的多数股权，该交易已获 FCA 批准。GII 表示计划将该平台从英国房地产拓展至更广泛的另类投资领域，重点发展符合伊斯兰教法的创收型投资、私人信贷和股权挂钩产品，并探索受监管的代币化及扩大地理覆盖范围。Better 将继续作为 LHX 的战略少数股东。
